Aisha (People Ops): Heads-up: our ATS vendor announced a short read-only window tonight 11pm PT for maintenance. Past incidents: assignments detach + some scorecards unlinked. We need a lightweight ops playbook. Tom (Recruiter): Copy. Can we gate scheduling and pause notifications during the window? I can also pause any offer sends. :folded_hands: Ravi (HRIS): I'll flip a 'maintenance_mode' flag that prevents webhook deliveries to calendar and blocks new schedule API calls. Will post when live. Maya (Eng): I'll snapshot relevant tables and produce a diff tool. Also will prepare a dry-run reassign script that only logs changes. DevOps Bot: Scheduled maintenance alert: ATS provider read-only from 2026-03-23T06:00:00Z for ~30m. Aisha (People Ops): Action list: 1) Block scheduling & webhooks (Ravi) 2) Hold candidate-facing emails (Tom) 3) DB snapshot + reconcile tools (Maya) 4) Candidate comms template (Tom) 5) After-action doc (Aisha). Confirm owners? Tom (Recruiter): Confirmed; holding offer email pipeline at 23:05 PT. Ravi (HRIS): maintenance_mode flag deployed to staging; will promote to prod at T-15. Will also capture webhook payloads to /var/log/ats_webhooks.log for troubleshooting. Maya (Eng): Posting planned snapshot steps for on-call: ```bash
# pre-maintenance snapshot
pg_dump -t public.interviewer_assignments --data-only --column-inserts > /tmp/interviewer_assignments_before.sql
psql -c "\copy (select id, interview_id, interviewer_id, created_at from public.interviewer_assignments where created_at > now() - interval '14 days') to '/tmp/assignments_before.csv' csv"
# post-maintenance comparison
psql -c "\copy (select id, interview_id, interviewer_id, created_at from public.interviewer_assignments where created_at > now() - interval '14 days') to '/tmp/assignments_after.csv' csv"
# quick diff
python3 scripts/csv_diff.py /tmp/assignments_before.csv /tmp/assignments_after.csv > /tmp/assignments_delta.log
``` Maya (Eng): Reassign script is currently a dry-run that outputs candidates and suggested interviewer mapping. It will require Ravi's ack file to apply. Ravi (HRIS): Ack process sounds good. I'll watch the delta log and only generate ack if changes are unambiguous. Aisha (People Ops): What's the visible impact if scorecards get orphaned? Tom (Recruiter): Interviewers report they cannot find scorecard links from the interview UI; they often DM recruiting. We then reconnect manually. Costly time sink. Maya (Eng): For relinking, heuristic: match candidate_id + scheduled_at window + reviewer email. I'll write a migration that writes to a pending_relink table and flags ambiguous matches. Ravi (HRIS): Also enabling retention of webhook payloads will help reconstruct mapping when assignment ids vanish. DevOps Bot: Reminder: maintenance starts in 10 minutes (2026-03-23T05:50:00Z). Aisha (People Ops): Candidate-facing blurb: "Were performing a short scheduling maintenance. Some interview links or scheduling changes may be delayed by up to 45 minutes. If your interview is impacted, our team will reach out." Tom (Recruiter): I'll queue that and hold send until maintenance completes. Maya (Eng): On-call runbook: 1) Check /tmp/assignments_delta.log 2) If >5 missing assignments, run dry-run reassign and post suggestions in thread 3) Ravi to ack before apply 4) If scorecards orphaned, run relink migration in pending mode and review ambiguous list. Aisha (People Ops): I'll collect timestamps and artifacts for the postmortem. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have your item covered.
